text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Bunga Kesidang - (built 1982) 65,921 dwt sold to clients o Greek broker for $9.5 million "as is", special survey and drydock due.
Pacificway - (built 1976) 65,585 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.3 million.
Androleon - (built 1976) 48,280 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4 million.
Fir Grove - (built 1989) sold to German buyers for $12.6 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
